milestones.name: Unlock shortcut to Apartments level of The Severed Spine
milestones.note: Door unlocked after using grapple point to reach Rostam's side; opens shortcut back to Apartments level

milestones.name: Defeat Acat, Nacre Engraver
milestones.note: Boss guarding the gates of Metropolis; easy encounter focused on movement and using Hairpin

milestones.name: Find first Old Core
milestones.note: Found in Mechanical Remains inside a broken building after beating Acat; special currency used to purchase upgrades from Mel

milestones.name: Unlock the Attuner
milestones.note: Unlocked by running to the end of the path inside Metropolis

zones.name: The Severed Spine
zones.fingerprintHint: Multi-level zone with Apartments level; contains grapple points, Nacre Basins, Crystalliser, and gauntlet rooms

zones.name: The Severed Spine - Apartments
zones.fingerprintHint: A level within The Severed Spine; accessible via shortcut door unlocked near Rostam

zones.name: Metropolis
zones.fingerprintHint: Next zone after The Severed Spine; gated by boss Acat; contains broken building with Mechanical Remains and the Attuner at the end of the path

abilities.name: Hairpin
abilities.note: Core movement ability used in combat; key mechanic for getting behind Acat during boss fight

abilities.name: Attuner
abilities.note: Unlocked by running to the end of the path in Metropolis; purpose elaborated in later walkthrough parts

abilities.name: Old Core
abilities.grants: Special currency used to purchase upgrades from Mel
abilities.note: First one found in Mechanical Remains in a broken building near the gate to Metropolis

bosses.name: Acat, Nacre Engraver
bosses.note: Guards the gates of Metropolis. Has two phases: Phase 1 - can only hit forward, vulnerable to attacks from behind using Hairpin. Phase 2 - leaps into arena center, slams down three times creating vertical shockwaves; use arena grapple points to stay airborne. Compared in difficulty to Egis.

objectives.name: Use Crystalliser to condense Nacre Droplets
objectives.hopDescription: Interact with Crystalliser to preserve Nacre Droplets before proceeding
objectives.note: Optional but recommended before gauntlet room

objectives.name: Clear the gauntlet room
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat all enemies in the gauntlet to open the door on the right and proceed

objectives.name: Unlock shortcut to Apartments
objectives.hopDescription: Use grapple point to reach Rostam's door, then unlock it to open shortcut back to Apartments level
objectives.leadsToMilestone: Unlock shortcut to Apartments level of The Severed Spine

objectives.name: Heal at Nacre Basin before boss
objectives.hopDescription: Go left from the shortcut door to find a Nacre Basin and heal up before the Acat boss fight

objectives.name: Defeat Acat, Nacre Engraver
objectives.hopDescription: Stay on Acat's back using Hairpin, survive shockwaves in Phase 2 with arena grapple points, defeat him to open the gate to Metropolis

objectives.name: Interact with Torn Overseer
objectives.hopDescription: Head left after beating Acat, interact with Torn Overseer on the ground to send it back

objectives.name: Find Old Core in Mechanical Remains
objectives.hopDescription: Enter broken building after the gate, jump to the left part of the room, interact with Mechanical Remains to find the first Old Core

objectives.name: Unlock the Attuner
objectives.hopDescription: Go inside Metropolis and run to the end of the path to unlock the Attuner

objectives.name: Return to The Severed Spine
objectives.hopDescription: After unlocking the Attuner, backtrack to The Severed Spine before continuing further into Metropolis
objectives.note: Explicitly flagged as necessary step before progressing further
